preconditions.description: The string s is non-empty and its length does not exceed 10^6.
The number of queries n is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all('a' <= c <= 'z' for c in s) and all(all('a' <= c <= 'z' for c in x) for x in queries)
preconditions.description: Both s and all query strings consist only of lowercase English letters.
The total length of all query strings does not exceed 10^6.
The number of query strings matches the integer n provided.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n lines, one for each query.

postconditions.expression: all(output_lines[i] == str(count_cyclical_matches(s, queries[i])) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: For each query i, the i-th output line is the count of consecutive substrings of s that are cyclical isomorphic to queries[i].
